reading: Todd Blanche, a top US government lawyer, did not answer some questions about Nvidia.
He did not say whether the government was checking the company.
Jensen Huang is back as Nvidia's leader.
Trump said he helped Huang get his job back.
Some US lawmakers, who make laws, want answers about Trump's part in Huang's return.
Huang is still expected to answer lawmakers' questions next week.
Huang said sorry to Nvidia workers on Tuesday, according to reports.
He said his mistakes were very bad.
